reference_source: Production BOM references whose route starts with JLC_
battery_temperature_sensor: DTP401525-XE pack NTC through J2; no TH1
coordinate_convention: Board X right, board Y down, viewed from top; both sides use same XY frame. Position CSV Y is negated. No bottom mirroring applied.
limitations: Pin numbers reflect design footprint; supplier tape orientation and physical pin-1 marking require independent comparison.
Diode/LED/FET polarity cannot be inferred from pad number 1 alone.
Do not use top-view bottom coordinates as a bottom-view assembly drawing without mirroring.
